name: loose-baseline
label: Loose Baseline
desc: Control. Shipped loose baseline with the concluded 6c requote deadband applied; every other arm is read against it.
thesis: The shipped defaults are the reference: any arm must beat this to earn a change.
worst_catalyst: Shipped 3c default, no env knob: orphan exits 64.9% (24/37)
worst_catalyst_desc: From #799 live run 2026-11-05: 24 exits on 37 closes (-$6.86), worst -$1.12 min 4.3 atp-heide-prado. Applied BOT_ORDER_REQUOTE_DEAD_BAND_USD=0.06 for #938.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: holding queue through the opening print turns those 24 exits into fills; if exits persist, the deadband is not the mechanism.

name: tight-touch
label: Tight Touch
desc: Balanced 0.50x offset, 2-4c: the tweak reaches leg two instead of hugging the mid at the tightest offset.
thesis: A 2-4c band reaches leg two where the 0.25x offset starved it.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #799 live run 2026-11-05: 26 exits on 42 closes (-$7.00), worst -$1.62 min 69.1 nba-phi-det. Applied BOT_QUOTE_TOURNAMENT_PRESET=balanced for #938.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: the 0.50x 2-4c band reaches leg two where 0.25x starved it; if orphans persist, width is not the mechanism.

name: balanced-mid
label: Balanced Mid
desc: The middle preset: proportional volatility tracking without the aggressive clamp.
thesis: A 2-4c band trades some edge for reach, which should merge more pairs than the wide arms.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #799 live run 2026-11-05: 21 exits on 36 closes (-$3.92, best total), worst -$1.62 min 69.0 nba-phi-det. Applied BOT_ORDER_REQUOTE_DEAD_BAND_USD=0.06 for #938.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: holding the resting quote through the run turns the minute-69 exit into a merge.

name: wide-shield
label: Wide Shield
profile: conservative preset 0.75x / 2-5c + 5c absolute stop (tweak applied: was 8c)
desc: Widest preset offset with a loose loss stop, sized to survive volatile books.
thesis: In volatility the cushion matters more than the fill: wide offset plus a 5c stop cuts the tail without firing on spread noise.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #799 live run 2026-11-05: 22 exits on 34 closes (-$6.10), worst -$1.00 min 24.1 atp-heide-prado. Applied BOT_RISK_STOP_ADVERSE_DROP_USD=0.050 for #938.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: a 5c stop cuts the tail the 8c leash sized up.

name: prudent-hybrid
label: Prudent Hybrid
desc: The hybrid preset between conservative and balanced, with the preset's 4c clamp lifted to 6c so it is not the same arm as balanced.
thesis: A 0.60x multiplier is the compromise: enough cushion for swings, close enough to fill.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #799 live run 2026-11-05: 25 exits on 42 closes (-$5.26), worst -$1.12 min 4.3 atp-heide-prado. Applied BOT_ORDER_REQUOTE_DEAD_BAND_USD=0.06 for #938.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: a 6c hold turns the minute-4 orphan into a fill with no stop change.

name: static-floor-2c
label: Dynamic Offset On
profile: dynamic offset ON (tweak applied: was fixed 2c floor)
desc: Volatility tracking switched on; quotes widen with the book instead of resting a flat 2c under the mid.
thesis: A tracking offset prices volatile books wider, so no $8.30 orphan forms on a $0.06 market.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #799 live run 2026-11-05: 1 close on fpd-pun-sca, $8.30 to $0.60 (10 shares @ $0.06), 72% of the arm's -$10.63. Applied BOT_QUOTE_GATE_DYNAMIC_OFFSET_ON=1 for #938.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: a tracking offset never builds the $8.30 orphan; a new worst single above ~$2 means the orphan is structural, not static.

name: low-churn-deadband
label: Low Churn Deadband
profile: static 2c + 6c requote dead band (tweak applied: was 10c)
desc: Static 2c offset with a 6c requote deadband: fewer requotes than baseline, but reprices before a stale quote fills.
thesis: Churn is the cost: holding a resting quote through small moves keeps queue position and cuts cancel/repost fees.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #799 live run 2026-11-05: 22 exits on 38 closes (-$4.46), worst -$1.17 min 67.8 nba-phi-det. Applied BOT_ORDER_REQUOTE_DEAD_BAND_USD=0.06 for #938.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: 6c still suppresses micro-churn but re-prices before a stale quote fills.

name: hair-trigger-2c
label: Hair Trigger 4.5c
profile: 4.5c absolute stop on a naked leg (tweak applied: was 2c)
desc: Single-leg stop armed at 4.5c: later than the earliest exit the shipped risk modes allow.
thesis: A naked leg is an unchosen bet; 4.5c fires on a genuine adverse move instead of spread noise.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #799 live run 2026-11-05: 37 exits against 2 merges (-$9.32), worst -$1.49 min 80.5 nhl-ott-buf. Applied BOT_RISK_STOP_ADVERSE_DROP_USD=0.045 for #938.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: 4.5c fires on real moves, not noise; merge count should rise from 2.

name: patient-stop-9c
label: Patient Stop 6c
profile: 6c absolute stop on a naked leg (tweak applied: was 9c)
desc: Single-leg stop armed at 6c: a circuit breaker rather than decoration.
thesis: Most 2-5c drops are noise a hedge can still recover; a 6c stop only cuts legs that truly broke.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #799 live run 2026-11-05: 22 exits on 36 closes (-$8.16), worst -$1.20 min 57.6 fpd-pun-sca. Applied BOT_RISK_STOP_ADVERSE_DROP_USD=0.060 for #938.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: 6c keeps the stop a circuit breaker instead of decoration.

name: queue-clear-5m
label: Queue Clear 3m
profile: queue-clear gate on, 3-minute max clear (tweak applied: was 5m)
desc: Only quotes books whose queue is likely to clear inside three minutes.
thesis: A quote stuck behind a slow queue is dead capital; refusing those books should lift fill quality per order.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #799 live run 2026-11-05: 24 exits on 42 closes (-$5.79), worst -$1.20 min 4.2 atp-heide-prado. Applied BOT_ORDER_QUEUE_MAX_CLEAR_MIN=3 for #938.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: a 3-minute window excludes uncertain books; quote count falls but quality per quote rises.
